source_text:
περ ἐστὶν ἀληθὲς ὅτι πᾶν τὸ ἐν γενέσει, καὶ παρενεχθὲν ἐκ τοῦ
μὴ ὄντος εἰς τὸ εἶναι, πάντη τε καὶ πάντω
pass_a_gloss: …indeed it is true that every thing in generation, and brought-across from the not-being into the being, wholly both and entirely…
pass_b_english: …it is true that everything in generation, and brought over from non-being into being, wholly and entirely…
